name: The Pee-OV Update
changes: Hush Money is now FIRST PERSON. You're not watching the crook anymore. You ARE the crook. Please act accordingly.
Every house, room, door and lamp is in 3D now. The dog is also in 3D. The dog is much closer than you think.
Click the game to look around with the mouse. On phones, drag your right thumb. Your neck is now a game mechanic.
Casing the house now flies a camera over the whole lot before swooping into your head. Very cinematic. Still illegal.
Look at loot to grab it. You no longer have to stand on top of a vase like a confused pigeon.
Security cameras now show a red cone. If you're standing in the red cone, that's on you.
Walls finally block light. Your flashlight no longer illuminates the neighbour's bathroom. Privacy, restored.
Press B for the drip cam: a quick over-the-shoulder view so you can admire your outfit mid-crime.
YOU CAN PEE NOW. Hold X. It leaves a puddle. Owners slip on it. Dogs stop to sniff it. We are very proud of this.
New prank: pee in every bathroom. Your mother would be so disappointed. +1 token.
New challenge and title for peeing in houses. Achievement unlocked: public menace.
The bots are gone. Gary, Zoli and Kinga have retired to a farm upstate. Solo is just you now, and the quota got smaller to match.
Online crews are real people only. Find friends. Or enemies. Either works.
New character screen: the Locker Room. Your crook on a podium, every slot on the side, every item in a grid. Very fashion week.
Filters for ALL, OWNED and NEW, so you can finally find that hat you unboxed three weeks ago.
New Create tab in the locker: draw your own hat, mask or outfit on top of your crook and send it in. The best ones end up in cases.
Look in the hideout mirror and press E to change your look without leaving the run. Drip on the go.
Brand new settings screen with search, a live preview and actual explanations. Turns out 'Darkness: MED' meant something.
Look sensitivity and field of view are now smooth sliders. Go full fisheye. We won't judge.
Same-keyboard two-player is gone: first person only has one pair of eyes. Play online together instead.
Dogs are still violent. Now in first person. It's a feature.

name: The Drip Update
changes: Brand new crooks. Same crimes, better drip.

Every crook is now a paperdoll: hat, face, eyes, top, gloves, pants, shoes and back item are all separate. Wear a crown, a clown nose, a tux and bunny slippers at the same time. We won't stop you. Nobody can stop you.
Every cosmetic you already own got redrawn for the new body. Your unlocks are safe. Your dignity was never safe.
New slots: eyes, pants and shoes. Star eyes, angry eyes, sleepy eyes. Camo, plaid and gold pants. Flippers. Yes, flippers. For heists.
New outfits: the jersey and the sharp suit. Dress for the job you want (burglar).
The crooks are a bit taller now so you can actually see the drip. Names and titles moved up so they stop sitting on your face.
The hideout got rebuilt from scratch. It's four rooms now: Sal's shop, the crew lounge, the back room and the garage.
Stock in Sal's shop sits in glass cases and on shelves now, instead of floating in mid-air like a haunted yard sale.
Look at any case and Sal's screen opens right on that item. Sal pretends he didn't see you looking. He saw.
The crew lounge has a couch, a TV with the leaderboard, an arcade machine nobody's allowed to touch, your trophies, the mirror and the challenge board.
The van lives in the garage now. Walk up to it to go to work, like a professional criminal.
The roulette table moved to the back room, where gambling belongs.
Sal's cat sits on the counter now, instead of hovering next to it like a ghost.
No more reinstalling! The desktop app now downloads new versions of the game on its own when you open it. Updates just... happen. Like magic. Like crime.
When the app itself needs an update, it asks once, updates itself and restarts. Never drag anything to the Trash again.
Offline? It plays the last version it downloaded. Your heists work on a plane. Please don't rob the plane.
You need to install this version by hand one last time. After that, never again. Pinky promise. Crook's honour.
Fixed online players not being able to open Sal's shop in the new hideout. Sal is open to everyone. For a price.

name: The Open House Update
changes: Houses now have outsides. Scientists are calling it "architecture".
You now park on the street like a normal law-abiding van. Nothing suspicious about four people in balaclavas carrying a jukebox across the lawn.
Loot doesn't count until it's in the van. "I was holding it" is not a business model.
Front doors, back doors, side doors, garages and windows all work as entrances now. The chimney does not. We checked. Please stop asking.
Windows! Big stuff won't fit through them. We tried it with a statue. The statue won.
Garage doors are loud. Like, RRRRRUMBLE loud. Your call.
Yard dogs have been added. Dogs are still violent. It's still a feature. Outdoor dogs are somehow worse.
Motion floodlights. If one lights you up, stand very still and pretend to be a garden gnome. It won't work. (Cutting the power does.)
Sprinklers now exist, and they don't care about your plans. Wet electronics lose 15% of their value. Sal will notice.
Some houses have a pool. Walking through the pool is loud. Walking through the pool with a laptop is a $300 mistake.
Gravel is loud. Gravel has always been loud. Gravel will outlive us all.
A nosy neighbour may be watching from next door. He has no job and infinite free time. If he sees you, he calls the cops. If his light is off, he's asleep. Probably.
Hedges and trees block line of sight. Dignity does not.
When the cops come, they now actually drive up the street with the sirens on, instead of spawning in the wardrobe.

Rooms are no longer generated by a raccoon throwing dice. Houses now have real floor plans: bungalows, L-shaped ranches, two-storey family homes, narrow townhouses, farmhouses with a barn, and modern villas with a courtyard pool.
Every house has a household: the gamer teen, the art collector, the gym couple, the cat lady, the watch collector, the foodie and the surf bro. You'll find their stuff, and their mess.
The gym couple are light sleepers. The surf bro doesn't lock anything. The cat lady has at least four cats. We stopped counting.
Secret rooms are in. If a bookshelf looks a bit too smug, pull a book.
Some big houses have back stairs. Use them. Feel smart.
Some houses have an attic now. It's dusty, it creaks, and there's a ladder. The good stuff is always in the attic. Grandpa's clock is also in the attic. It weighs 90 kilos.
Penthouses have a roof terrace, a hot tub and an office tower across the street with one guy working late. He can see you. He's not paid enough to care. Probably.
Big hauls now have a street out front too, so the jewellers, the mall, the museum and the casino all get a grand entrance. Use it. Or don't.
Kitchens flow into living rooms now. It's called open plan. The owners love it. So do we, from the other side of the room.
Casing the house now tells you who lives there, every way in, and everything outside that wants to ruin your night.
You get 20 extra seconds a night, because the van is further away now. You're welcome.
Sal's shop got a full makeover. Sal did not. Sal will never change.
Sal talks now, and you can haggle with him. He will still win.
You can take out loans from Sal now. Pay them back. We cannot stress this enough. Pay them back.
Scratch cards added. Gambling problems sold separately.
59 new kinds of loot, including a surfboard, a grill, a kettlebell and a jukebox. Your van has opinions about the jukebox.
The police chase is 3D now. It no longer looks like a flash game from 2007. It looks like a flash game from 2009.
Fixed the bug where the boss said you needed $1.4k, the screen said $1.2k and your mate said $1.1k. Everyone was lying. Now only the boss lies.

name: The Violent Dog Update
changes: Redeem codes! Type one in the menu and get tokens, items or a title. No, "FREEMONEY" is not a code. We checked that one too.
Titles: earn them and wear them above your head, in the lobby and on the leaderboard. Finally, people will know who carried.
The cart was reworked. It steers now. It slides off door frames instead of marrying them.
Online: you can gamble together at the roulette table. Lose money as a team.
Online: smoother movement and a smoother police chase for players who join. The host's internet is still the host's problem.
The house intro only skips when everyone presses a button. No more being speedrun by your mate.
Quit to menu now actually quits. Before, you were in the menu AND the game. Schrödinger's heist.
Lamps stay off while the power is cut. Physics is back.
The dog is still violent. It's a feature.
Fixed the extreme lag for players who join a game. You can now see the owner coming BEFORE he tackles you.
Online play now talks directly between players when it can, and falls back to the server when it can't. Like a good getaway driver.
The Mac app is signed now, so macOS stops calling it "damaged". It was never damaged. It was misunderstood.
Clearer update steps on this page. Delete the old app first. Yes, really.
